name: hydraweb
description: HydraWeb — AI-powered website generation and vibe coding SaaS platform

scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.api:install: cd services/api && uv pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.api:migrate: cd services/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:seed: cd services/api && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.api:dev: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
